title: Det-extremal cubic graphs and the total domatic number
summary: A graph $G$ is det-extremal if $|\operatorname{det} A|=\operatorname{per} A$ for its adjacency matrix $A$. Det-extremal cubic bipartite graphs arise in the study of Pólya's permanent problem, and McCuaig characterized the $3$-connected ones as vertex-sums of copies of the Heawood graph. The total domatic number of a graph is the largest number of pairwise disjoint total dominating sets. Characterization of the cubic graphs with total domatic number $1$ has been a long-standing open problem.
